title: Coordinate Student V0.1 Wave 1 targeted R1 rework
purpose: Persist the minimum corrective coordination after Wave 1 role results: freeze the accepted JOB 02 head, require durable publication for JOB 01, and require exact V2-regression requalification for JOB 03 before FAN-IN A. This package changes coordination/docs only and does not repair product code itself.
invariants: JOB 02 exact accepted head 6c91346d07c934cfb2917799084647b13e4fb931 remains frozen and is not reworked.
JOB 01 cannot enter FAN-IN A with RESULT_SHA NOT_PUBLISHED or with PR metadata that does not identify PR 387.
JOB 01 R1 is publication/evidence rework first; semantic redesign is forbidden unless exact rerun evidence proves a semantic defect.
JOB 03 R1 must distinguish an actual V2 regression from the generic Learn-it Next CI router failure on an unrecognized branch.
JOB 03 must not edit .github workflows or central routing to make its role CI green; such integration routing remains FAN-IN ownership.
No role branch is merged by this coordination package.
FAN-IN A remains blocked until JOB 01 and JOB 03 both return exact durable PASS heads.
requiredEvidence: Repository governance passes on the exact R1-control head.
JOB 01 R1 returns a 40-hex RESULT_SHA present on PR 387 and proves changed paths stay within ATLAS-WP-027.
JOB 03 R1 returns a 40-hex RESULT_SHA present on PR 389 and reports the exact V2 regression command/result separately from generic CI routing.
JOB 02 accepted head remains byte-identical to the head already reported by PR 388.
adversarialTests: A narrative PASS without a published JOB 01 commit remains HOLD.
A JOB 01 result naming PR 385 instead of PR 387 remains invalid metadata.
A JOB 03 fix that edits .github or broadens its role scope fails rework qualification.
A generic CI-router failure must not be silently relabeled as a V2 semantic regression or vice versa.
Any mutation to accepted JOB 02 before FAN-IN invalidates the frozen-head assumption and requires requalification.
nonGoals: Implementing JOB 01 or JOB 03 code in the control stream.
Starting FAN-IN A while a role is held.
Changing learnit.kit.v4, prior v2/v3 semantics or the Wave 1 interface freeze.
Repairing central CI routing before the integration role owns that decision.
independentReview: Exact PR heads and changed paths are read from GitHub rather than accepted from worker narration alone.
Repository governance and PR-scope automation independently qualify this coordination-only package.
JOB 04 will independently bind only exact role PASS heads and will not consume held or unpublished results.
rollback: Close the R1-control PR and delete its branch. Product role branches remain unchanged and FAN-IN A remains blocked.
